_comment: The leaf-proof wire between the host listener (`POST /v1/solana/leaf-proofs`, coprocessor/fhevm-engine/host-listener/src/http_server.rs) and the KMS connector (kms-connector/crates/kms-worker/src/core/solana/proof.rs). Both sides pin their spelling against this file: the listener deserializes `request` and serializes every `proofs` variant; the connector serializes `request` and deserializes `proofs`. Byte fields are 32 bytes as lowercase hex without a prefix.
